extension.news:
[COLORorangered][B]v4.0.0[/B][/COLOR]
[B]New features[/B] - Search: find channels, groups, series and playlists across all your lists from one place, with results grouped by type - Virtual folders: organize playlists into custom folders with your own names and icons - Favorites: add any channel to favorites from the context menu, reorder them freely, jump straight back to the channel's original list and group - Custom favorites: manually add your own channel by name and URL - Recently watched: keeps a history of everything you play, with quick access to jump back in or resume the last channel - Random channel: instantly play a random channel from any list, group, series or your favorites - Manual sorting: switch any list or group between alphabetical and original order from its context menu - Series grouping: episodes are collected into their own folders instead of cluttering the channel list - Diagnostics: "Check sources & playlists" tool validates all your sources and shows a clear OK/failure status for each - Breadcrumb headers: always see which list or section you are currently browsing
[B]Playlists[/B] - Xtream Codes lists are set up automatically, including their EPG - Damaged playlists are repaired on the fly, so broken entries no longer cost you channels - Global logo source, plus an optional database that fills in logos for channels that have none
[B]EPG improvements[/B] - Live program info with now/next details, duration, genres and artwork directly in channel listings - Smarter channel matching: country-aware detection greatly reduces wrong EPG data on multi-country lists - Reliable fallback: when the primary EPG source has no live data, a backup source is used automatically - Global EPG source for lists that come without their own - Much faster EPG loading and rendering, most noticeable on large channel lists - EPG data is prepared in the background, so browsing stays smooth
[B]Playback[/B] - Auto-reconnect: live streams cut off by the provider are restored automatically, without leaving the player - Faster channel start - Better automatic detection of HLS and DASH streams for adaptive playback - Radio and audio-only streams are recognized and played correctly, with their own icon - Movies and series play reliably even when the file name does not match the actual video format - New "Play via FFmpeg (no adaptive)" context option as a manual fallback when a stream won't start normally
[B]Fixes & stability[/B] - Cache cleanup no longer leaves stale temporary files behind - Settings changes now apply immediately after closing the settings dialog - Fixed cases where the diagnostics progress dialog could get stuck on screen - Fixed search skipping remaining channels when a playlist entry was malformed - Numerous smaller fixes in channel titles, categories, grouping and sorting - General performance and stability improvements throughout the addon
